electron-builder.name: Electron + electron-builder
electron-builder.description: Electron host serving a packed .wvb over app://, packaged into installers with electron-builder.
caveats: Builtin bundles are installed during electron-builder's afterPack, so they appear only in packaged builds (the `dist` script), not when you run the app in development. Use the `bundles` script (or `start`) to stage them locally.

electron-forge.name: Electron + Electron Forge
electron-forge.description: Electron host serving a packed .wvb over app://, packaged with Electron Forge.
caveats: The Forge plugin installs builtin bundles only when you run `package` or `make`. Running the app in development does not — run the `bundles` script (or `start`) to stage them into `bundles/` yourself.
